05. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.
Since these two bail applications arise out of one and same case record, the same are heard together and disposed of by this common order with the consent of the learned counsel for the parties.

3. These are applications U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioners for grant of bail in connection with Kutra P.S. Case No. 44 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.46 of 2023 pending in the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-PO, Special Court(POCSO), Sundargarh, for commission of offences punishable U/Ss. 363/376-DA/506 of IPC read with Sec. 6 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of kidnapping the victim aged about less than 16 years and committing gang rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon her.

3. Heard, Mr.Parsuram Panda, learned proxy counsel appearing on behalf of Mr.Bikash Kumar Dash, learned counsel for the petitioners; Ms.Anisha Prusty, learned Legal Aid defence counsel appearing virtually for the victim and Mr. P.Satapathy, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record including the copy of deposition of the victim.

4. The victim in her evidence has not whispered a single word against the petitioners and the petitioners are in custody since 05.04.2023/ 06.04.2023.
In such view of the matter, this Court without expressing any view on merits, admits the petitioners to bail.

5. Hence, the bail applications of the petitioners Rohit Dungdung in BLAPL No. 4789 of 2025,
Karmu Minz & Deepak Nayak @ Chhapan Naik in BLAPL No. 4845 of 2025 stand allowed and they are allowed to go on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty-five Thousand)
with one solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin of the case on such terms and conditions as deems fit and proper by it.
6. Accordingly, both the BLAPLs stand disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
Digitally Signed (G. Satapathy)
